title: Identification of biomarkers of Shenhailong formula in benign prostatic hyperplasia treatment: An observation study using network pharmacology and Mendelian randomization analysis.
authors: Pan, Jia; Yu, Mengyao; Zhang, Lihan; Yin, Jing; Liu, Jie; Zhang, Shuwu; Zhang, Peihai; Fan, Qingying; Liu, Jiatong; Li, Xiaoyuan
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过网络药理学、孟德尔随机化和分子对接识别中药复方治疗良性前列腺增生的生物标志物，虽涉及转录因子GATA2/JUN和分子对接，但核心是疾病靶点与药物成分，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制研究。
abstract: Shenhailong formula, a classic herbal prescription, shows potential in treating benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH), but its candidate components and mechanisms remain unclear. This study aimed to preliminarily clarify its therapeutic mechanisms in BPH using network pharmacology, Mendelian randomization (MR), and molecular docking. In this study, BPH-related datasets were first obtained from Gene Expression Omnibus database, and different expression analysis was performed to identify differentially expression genes. Meanwhile, Chinese herbs related target genes and BPH-related target genes were retrieved from public database, and candidate genes were screened by taking the intersection of the 3 above. Subsequently, MR analysis was conducted to explore the causal relationship between candidate genes and BPH, and then biomarkers were generated through expression level validation. Finally, enrichment analysis, molecular regulatory network construction, and molecular docking were performed. By integrating 779 BPH-related target genes, 2879 Chinese herb-related target genes, and 3106 differentially expression genes, 41 candidate genes were obtained. MR analysis revealed that 12 genes had potential causal relationships with BPH. Eventually, 3 biomarkers were identified: serum/glucocorticoid-regulated kinase 1, epidermal growth factor, and ectonucleotide pyrophosphatase/phosphodiesterase family member 1. All 3 biomarkers were significantly enriched in the "kras signaling dn," "pancreas beta cells," "estrogen response early," "estrogen response late," and "spermatogenesis" pathways (gene set enrichment analysis, false discovery rate < 0.05). " Furthermore, transcription factors GATA2 and JUN exerted their influence on 3 biomarkers, and the actions of hsa-miR-4459 and hsa-miR-4433a-3p were involved in the regulation of epidermal growth factor and ectonucleotide pyrophosphatase/phosphodiesterase family member 1. Additionally, molecular docking showed that Stepholidine and Adenosine triphosphate had higher affinity within biomarkers, which were the potential candidate components for treating BPH with Shenhailong formula, supported by their strong binding affinity with the protein of biomarkers. This study revealed the potential targets and potential candidate components of Shenhailong formula in the treatment of BPH, and confirmed that they had strong affinity. It provided a theoretical basis for the treatment of BPH with Shenhailong formula.
abstract_zh: 神海龙方作为一种经典中药复方，在治疗良性前列腺增生（BPH）方面显示出潜力，但其候选成分和作用机制仍不清楚。本研究旨在通过网络药理学、孟德尔随机化（MR）和分子对接，初步阐明其在BPH中的治疗机制。本研究中，首先从Gene Expression Omnibus数据库获取BPH相关数据集，并进行差异表达分析以识别差异表达基因。同时，从公共数据库检索中药相关靶基因和BPH相关靶基因，并通过取上述三者的交集筛选候选基因。随后，进行MR分析以探讨候选基因与BPH之间的因果关系，然后通过表达水平验证生成生物标志物。最后，进行富集分析、分子调控网络构建和分子对接。通过整合779个BPH相关靶基因、2879个中药相关靶基因和3106个差异表达基因，获得41个候选基因。MR分析显示，12个基因与BPH存在潜在因果关系。最终，鉴定出3个生物标志物：血清/糖皮质激素调节激酶1、表皮生长因子和外核苷酸焦磷酸酶/磷酸二酯酶家族成员1。所有3个生物标志物在“kras signaling dn”、“pancreas beta cells”、“estrogen response early”、“estrogen response late”和“spermatogenesis”通路中显著富集（基因集富集分析，错误发现率 < 0.05）。此外，转录因子GATA2和JUN对3个生物标志物产生影响，hsa-miR-4459和hsa-miR-4433a-3p的作用参与表皮生长因子和外核苷酸焦磷酸酶/磷酸二酯酶家族成员1的调控。另外，分子对接显示，Stepholidine和三磷酸腺苷在生物标志物中具有较高亲和力，这些是神海龙方治疗BPH的潜在候选成分，并得到其与生物标志物蛋白强结合亲和力的支持。本研究揭示了神海龙方治疗BPH的潜在靶点和潜在候选成分，并确认它们具有强亲和力，为神海龙方治疗BPH提供了理论基础。
